steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: Ahhh... Awooo...
The monster squeezes its massive body through the narrow valley, its black claws almost reaching you.
The quaking of the ground significantly slows you down. It's only a matter of time before you get caught.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's Schorl doing... Why hasn't it woken me up yet?
You try to tell yourself to stay calm, but the situation is making you extremely nervous.
Swish—
While you're distracted, a fierce attack strikes, grazing your back.
You feel something being drawn out from your back. Intense burning pain follows, almost making you scream.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: No!
The shackles' red light flickers, instantly forming spikes that fly toward the monster behind you.
But the attack that would have killed most Corruptors simply sinks into the monster's body silently like a rock dropping into the ocean.

steps.speaker: Monster
steps.content: Hiss... Hah...
The monster lets out a mocking scream, its huge red pupils staring straight at you, the rotten stench of decay assaulting your face.
The pain in your back becomes increasingly unignorable, burrowing deep into your body together with fear, blurring your vision.
In a daze, you see several hands cling to your body.

steps.speaker: Deranged Scholar
steps.content: ...I can't die here. I haven't reached the truth yet... Guide me, show me the way... Take me where the moon rises, beside the abyss... to see the Perishing Star that fell...

steps.speaker: Contorted Mantis Queen
steps.content: My companions... Our companions... I can't leave them behind... Let go of me. I must go back. I can't lose anyone else...

steps.speaker: Rusty Machine
steps.content: I'll just stay here... I'm already used to it. I'll accept any outcome... But you...

steps.speaker: Rusty Machine
steps.content: Why did you come? You know it's a trap. You know you can't change anything...

steps.speaker: Rusty Machine
steps.content: And the meeting alone causes you unbearable pain...

Shadows of the departed surround you and non-human arms climb onto your body, entangling your limbs. Their gruesome corpses force you to face the past while fear consumes your body and consciousness voraciously.
You try to escape, but the illusion morphs into a faceless girl with a torch whispering indistinctly, grabbing and pulling at you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Back off!
Fear takes over all thought. You want to retreat, afraid to see another dead face. But that person doesn't let go.
She lunges at you again, this time raising her weapon high, smashing it at you.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Wake up!!
A burst of sparks. It stings your eyes, changing the scene in your vision abruptly.
Before you, an ashen-faced Hestia raises her torch and smashes it down behind you repeatedly, each hit eliciting a scream. Startled awake, you realize you're entangled in the monster's tentacles.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Let go! Let go!! Let go of him!!!
steps.female_content: Let go! Let go!! Let go of her!!!

steps.content: Her tearful attack lacks strength, but the monster seems to suddenly weaken, howling as it releases the tentacles binding you. Dodging the sparks, it quickly retreats into the darkness, the massive impact shaking the ground.
Before you register what you see, she drags you up from the muddy ground.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: What are you waiting for?! Run!!
